test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Two pipes A and B can fill the tank in 5 hours and 8 hours, respectively. Pipe C can empty the same tank in 10 hours. Find the time taken to fill the empty tank when all the pipes are opened simultaneously.
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by pipe A to fill the tank = 5 hours.

Time taken by pipe B to fill the tank = 8 hours.

Time taken by pipe C to empty the tank = 10 hours.

**Formula Used:**

Net part of the tank filled in 1 hour when all pipes are opened = (Part filled by A in 1 hour) + (Part filled by B in 1 hour) - (Part emptied by C in 1 hour)

**Calculation:**

Part of the tank filled by A in 1 hour = 1/5

Part of the tank filled by B in 1 hour = 1/8

Part of the tank emptied by C in 1 hour = 1/10

Net part of the tank filled in 1 hour:

⇒ (1/5) + (1/8) - (1/10)

⇒ (1)/(5) + (1)/(8) - (1)/(10)

⇒ (8)/(40) + (5)/(40) - (4)/(40)

⇒ (8 + 5 - 4)/(40)

⇒ (9)/(40)

Time taken to fill the tank:

⇒ 1 / (Net part of the tank filled in 1 hour)

⇒ 1 / (9)/(40)

⇒ (40)/(9)

⇒ 4 4/9 hours

**The time taken to fill the empty tank when all the pipes are opened simultaneously is 4 4/9 hours.**
